# Experiment Matrix

Canonical map from **paper claim → hypothesis → experiment → command →
artifact → figure/table**. Every headline number in
[RESULTS.md](../RESULTS.md) has exactly one row here. Preregistration for
the v3 rows is in [preregistration.md](preregistration.md).

Legend: *Art.* = artifact under `runs/`; *Fig.* = script in `figures/`;
*Tab.* = table generated by `scripts/generate_tables.sh`.

---

## Traceability example (the intended workflow)

> **Claim (RESULTS.md §5A.4):** "the TopK SAE beats k-matched PCA 4.7× on FNO
> representations."
> 1. Find row **F1** above → command `python -m experiments.run_pipeline --stages 11`.
> 2. Artifact `runs/operator_boundary/operator_boundary_report.json` →
>    `sae.test_recon_mse` (≈ 7.0e-4) and `pca_k_recon` (≈ 3.3e-3).
> 3. Figure: `figures/figure_06_regime_boundary.py` reads exactly those
>    fields — no hand-entered numbers anywhere in the figure scripts.
> 4. Paper table: `paper/tables/table_regime_boundary.tex` (regenerated by
>    `scripts/generate_tables.sh` from the same JSON).
